findings.description: Default parameter reads localStorage outside the adapter try/catch.
findings.failure_scenario: Browser policy throws on accessing window.localStorage; the app crashes before rendering instead of displaying a non-blocking save warning.
findings.resolution: Resolve the default storage inside the try block. Regression failed with SecurityError before fix.

findings.description: A changed reel target can replay an old accepted request outside the spinning stage.
findings.failure_scenario: Adjust settings invalidates a ticket; target becomes the idle label and the requestId remains nonzero, so drums animate without a pull.
findings.resolution: Require the spinning stage before starting a WAAPI animation; clean up when the stage ends.

findings.description: System reduced motion changes during a handoff do not cancel the mounted WAAPI animation.
findings.failure_scenario: Runner enables reduced motion while opening; CSS media rules cannot stop the JS animation.
findings.resolution: Track the animation and settle the dialog immediately when reduced motion becomes active.

findings.description: Transition deduplication only tracks interval ID and is no longer consumed by the UI.
findings.failure_scenario: New runs reuse warmup-1; a previous identity can suppress the new cue, while repeated ticking should not reannounce cues.
findings.resolution: Include plan/run identity in transition identity and use it for the running live announcement. Test both duplicate and subsequent-run behavior.

findings.description: Close always focuses the lever, even when the ticket was opened from the outlet.
findings.failure_scenario: Keyboard runner opens View ticket and closes; focus returns to a different control.
findings.resolution: Remember the opening control, preserve the inert outlet control while the dialog is open, and restore it on Close.

findings.description: Initial lever rotation left its reserved rail.
findings.failure_scenario: Timed portrait frame showed the knob clipped at the viewport edge during the pull.
findings.resolution: Use forward pivot travel with perspective within the reserved rail; recapture timed evidence.

findings.description: Installation guidance initially used a non-modal open dialog.
findings.failure_scenario: Background controls remain interactive behind installation guidance.
findings.resolution: Use showModal and restore cleanup, Escape and autofocus; Safari installation journey passes.

findings.description: Physical iPhone/Android and real treadmill acceptance cannot be established in browser emulation.
findings.failure_scenario: Visual-only cues may be insufficient during actual exercise even when automated checks pass.
findings.escalation_note: Keep the PR draft until physical browser/installed checks and a real 15-minute treadmill session are performed; no physical acceptance is claimed.
